programme.title: TVP@TTV Pend. Islam Ting. 1 Ep03
programme.desc: Tajuk Makanan Halal Lagi Baik ini membincangkan tentang kita dituntut untuk mengambil makanan yang halal lagi baik. Untuk memperkembangkan lagi topik ini, murid diperjelaskan dengan maksud makanan halal dan makanan haram. Selain itu, topik ini juga menerangkan tentang akibat pengambilan makanan yang haram kepada rohani dan jasmani serta perbezaan ciri-ciri makanan halal dan makanan haram. Di samping itu, murid juga dapat menghuraikan pengajaran ayat berdasarkan Surah al-Baqarah ayat 168. Topik ini juga diakhiri dengan saranan aktiviti yang dapat murid lakukan di rumah sebagai amalan harian. Terdapat pentaksiran berbentuk formatif diberikan setelah selesai satu-satu sub-topik dibincangkan.

programme.desc: Rancangan ini membincangkan tentang kepentingan berdakwah, kupasan surah Fussilat (surah 41, ayat 33), menyelusuri gelombang dakwah semasa para anbiya hingga kini Tuntutan beramal soleh dan berbangga menjadi muslim turut dibincangkan.

programme.title: TVP@TTV Pend. Islam Ting. 1 Ep02
programme.desc: Topik ini menerangkan tentang pengertian jahiliah. Diperincikan hal kejahilan dalam bidang akidah dan akhlak serta pelbagai pegangan akidah yang dianuti oleh masyarakat jahiliyah. Kejahilan masyarakat Arab ini masih wujud dan ada di antaranya masih diamalkan sehingga sekarang. Murid murid dikehendaki meninggalkan akhlak buruk yang terdapat dalam masyarakat sekarang yang mirip kejahilan masyarakat arab jahiliyah. Penerangan berkenaan sebab Rasulullah S.A.W diutuskan kepada kaum arab jahiliah ketika itu di mana ianya membawa kebaikan dan perubahan positif terhadap masyarakat pada ketika itu.

programme.desc: Based on an urban legend amongst the Bangka Belitung community, Buyut is a mythological creature or water ghoul that lives in the bodies of water. The story begins when a newlywed couple Bima and Kanaya move into a home bought from an auction after its previous owners passed away. After a while, Kanaya begins to notice odd happenings occuring in their new home.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang Boleh?
programme.desc: Rose, Dharma's girlfriend, dies by suicide. Dharma and Rose's twin sister Seri cannot accept that Rose would take her own life. Indra, Dharma's colleague, also tries to help Dharma figure out Rose's death. During their investigations, Dharma is disturbed by all kinds of ghostly happenings. Indra and Seri do not believe in the supernatural and think that Dharma is making up all these things. In fact, Seri starts accusing Dharma of causing her twin to kill herself. Dharma must solve this puzzle as soon as he can.

programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: An aspiring flight attendant named Soo-hyeon agrees to a one-week part time job at a convenience store that pays suspiciously too well. What she initially thought would be easy money is nothing like she ever imagined as the strange customers and the mysterious store owner creates an unpredictable horror.

programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: Jin-kyeong, an emergency counselor from the suicide hotline, listens to the lamenting stories of suicidal people. However, one night, she picks up the call to hear her dead brother's voice on the line and Jin-kyeong is gripped with fear that she can't escape.

programme.title: The Eyes
programme.desc: The story begins after Trang, a famous artiste, awakens from coma following a horrific car accident. The traumatic injury leaves her with memory loss. She also has to undergo eye transplant surgery to regain her vision. But right after the surgery, Trang starts seeing a lady ghost with bloodshot eyes following her around. She decides to investigate the spooky encounters and discovers unimaginable secrets that her very own husband has been trying to hide from her.

programme.title: The Disapearance of Irdina Adhwa
programme.desc: A year after Irdina disappears, a few of her friends take a trip to an isolated part of Kundasang. Horror starts at midnight when Sofie finds another friend with his throat slit open. Sofie and the rest try to figure out how to survive until dawn, but one by one, they fall victim to a masked assailant. But one of them gets a glimpse of the man behind the mask, who forces the victim to look at a photograph of Irdina.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

Just before he dies, he tells Maya to return to her village. Months later, Maya and Dini are still struggling to survive. Maya decided to return to her village and seek help from her wealthy parents. Upon arrival in the rural, forested village, the villagers, led by Ki Saptadi, give her a cold reception.
